evidence_contract.raw_semantic_mask: DynamicMaskRefiner::getSemanticMask() immediately after the target-frame compute() call
evidence_contract.refined_static_mask: exact compute() return matrix passed to System::TrackRGBD, Tracking::GrabImageRGBD, Frame::Frame, and Frame::ExtractORB
evidence_contract.recovered_tracking_support: raw_dynamic_mask AND refined_static_mask, identical to the route-certificate recovered-support definition
evidence_contract.mapping_admission: staticWeight >= 0.5, identical to the route-certificate persistent-admission threshold
evidence_contract.recovered_admission_overlap: recovered_tracking_support AND mapping_admission; a direct route-admission diagnostic, not independent zero-ghost ground truth
evidence_contract.orb_keypoints: Tracking::mCurrentFrame.mvKeysUn copied by System after the target-frame TrackRGBD call
evidence_contract.orb_descriptors: Tracking::mCurrentFrame.mDescriptors from the same frame and extractor invocation
evidence_contract.orb_matches: one-to-one intersection of non-outlier post-tracking MapPoint IDs in the previous and current frames; these are persistent ORB-SLAM3 track correspondences, not independently recomputed OpenCV matches
evidence_contract.mask_serialization: binary 0/1 matrices multiplied by 255 only for lossless PNG storage

hash_manifest: provenance_manifest.json is generated by the replay finalizer after a successful run
